in_sanskrit.name: Navnath
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है New Birth, New Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Navnath एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Navanatha means 'New Birth, New Master'. In Hindu mythology, Navanatha is a term used for a devotee who has recently been initiated into a new spiritual path or guru. This name is a reminder of the continuous cycle of birth, death, and rebirth in Hinduism.
